taskContracts.objective: Define P72 DB-backed runtime primary contracts with DB writes and migrations disabled.

inputs.narrowScope: Define DB-backed runtime contracts only; no DB writes, migrations, schema mutation, or runtime storage mutation.
safetyRules: Do not enable DB writes, migrations, schema mutation, project mutation, provider dispatch, tool execution, worker execution, external network calls, deploy execution, release execution, export execution, package creation, or provider spend.
DB runtime records must be preview-only, fallback-aware, evidence-linked, approval-aware, cost-aware, and non-executing.
Primary UX must not expose raw JSON, raw logs, raw private project IDs, raw DB URLs, fake runnable DB actions, internal phase labels outside OS Roadmap, or DemoApp outside demo mode.

reuseCheck.rule: Reuse existing result, report, redaction, mode guard, phase status, Command Center, durable state, evidence, activity, and cost patterns; do not duplicate helpers.

uxUpdate.scope: No Command Center page behavior changes in P72.1.
uxUpdate.required: Future or changed UX must show DB primary state, fallback state, migration readiness, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner capability, evidence/activity location, safety posture, and cost impact.

dataShapes: runtimeId, dbPrimaryState, fallbackState, migrationState, dbWritesAllowed, migrationsAllowed, schemaMutationAllowed, disabledReason, blockers, evidenceRefs, activityRefs, costImpact, ownerCapability, nextAction

inputs.commandCenterUxRequirements: Command Center UX must show DB primary state, fallback state, migration readiness, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner capability, evidence/activity location, safety posture, and cost impact without raw JSON, raw logs, raw private IDs, raw DB URLs, DemoApp leakage, internal phase labels, or fake runnable DB actions.
playwrightTests: No new Playwright route is required for this subphase unless Command Center route behavior changes.
docsRoadmap: Update NEXUS platform roadmap and OS phase status.
inputs.phaseStatusUpdate: Mark P72.1 complete after validation and set nextPhase to P72.2.
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm DB writes, migrations, schema mutation, project mutation, provider dispatch, tool execution, worker execution, network calls, deploy/release/export execution, package creation, and provider spend were not enabled.
Confirm no projects/**, project-roadmap/**, db/**, prisma/**, or migrations/** files changed.
Confirm no fake DB actions were exposed.
Confirm primary UX does not expose raw JSON, raw logs, DemoApp leakage, internal phase labels, raw DB URLs, or raw private IDs.
gitCommands: git commit -m "docs(nexus): define p72 db runtime contract"

acceptanceCriteria: P72.1 is independently commit-ready.
No DB writes, migrations, schema mutation, project mutation, provider/tool execution, worker execution, network call, deploy/release/export execution, package creation, or provider spend is enabled.
Validation reports pass and OS phase status is current.
